data.name: GutterPunk
data.detailed_description:
GutterPunk is a first-person fast-paced action game, where you wall-run through a brutalist concrete hell to fuel a rebellion in a dystopian society. You play as Char is a young, energetic woman, born and raised in The Upper City but came down to the Lower City as she doesn’t work in the factories, names it slavery, and organizes secret underground raves instead during the day. But to set all of this up you will need to parkour over without letting them catch you during curfew.

Each wall-run will give you energy that you can use to perform jumps, dashes, slides and killing blows in quick succession. Killing the enemy robots is not necessary but gives you a speed boost which can provide the extra edge if chained correctly. Slowing time can give you a easier time but it won't slow down the actual timer. Try to reach to the end as fast as possible to ensure the rebellions victory and yours on the leaderboard.

This game was made by 6 students as a group project assignment for their third year in the bachelor Digital Arts & Entertainment at Hogeschool West-Vlaanderen in Belgium.

The music was composed by Louis Delisle, student at the Royal Conservatoire of Ghent.

data.short_description: A single-player speedrunning FPS game where you sprint across walls, building energy with each wall-run to perform parkour moves, as you race through brutalist concrete hell to fuel a rebellion in a dystopian society for the fastest and cleanest finish.
